landing.h1: The quiet alternative to the class WhatsApp group
landing.h2: Pictures and messages. No ClassDojo Plus.
landing.h3: Free for families. No Plus. No points. No kid login.
landing.lead: Ask Home or Grok what school is tomorrow. Open the feed only when you want the photos.
landing.ask: Ask Home or Grok what school is tomorrow.
consent.public_lead: Quiet by default. Photo opt-out and YOLO are a parent choice. Off until you turn them on. We do not claim a legal endorsement here.
landing.rgpd_note: This page is not an RGPD or GDPR endorsement.
landing.yolo_body: Default is quiet. Posts stay inside the group. Public or YOLO sharing is off unless a guardian opts in. We never put a child's face on an open page.
feed.compose_media: Photo and video files stay stub storage overnight. R2 EU comes later.
